For Immediate Release
January 20, 2003

Chad Brown
White Wolf Inc.
404-292-1819 ext. 254
ch...@white-wolf.com

White Wolf Announces 2003 European Vampire CCG Championship in Barcelona

Atlanta, GA‹White Wolf Publishing, Inc. announces that the 2003 Vampire: The
Eternal Struggle® European Championship will be held in Barcelona, Spain this
October.

Players from throughout Europe who qualify in 2003 National Championship
events will be invited to attend the European Championship in Barcelona and
pit their skills against fellow champions. All players are invited to attend,
however, because those not yet qualified in National Championships will still
have a chance to qualify in one final Qualifier Tournament held the day
before the European Championship. A complete list of Qualifier Tournaments
will be available at www.white-wolf.com/vtes later this month.

The 2003 Barcelona Championship will be hosted by Distrimagen, the Vampire
Elder Kindred Network (the official Vampire CCG player organization), the
Hispanic Conclave and White Wolf. Specific information on the tournament
(including registration, accommodations and public transportation info) will
be made available when the official 2003 European Championship website goes
online later this year. In the meantime, you can contact the president of the
Hispanic Conclave, Ginés Quiñonero, via email at (damna...@ono.com) and
check www.white-wolf.com/vtes for updates. The registration fee will be a
modest 10 euro, and the qualifying event and many other side events are open
to all players. Make plans to visit beautiful Barcelona and match wits with
the world¹s best players.

White Wolf has also announced that the 2004 European Championship will be
held in Germany.

Vampire: The Eternal Struggle (or V:TES) is White Wolf¹s signature
collectible card game (or CCG) based on its Vampire: The Masquerade
storytelling game. First published by Wizards of the Coast and more recently
by White Wolf itself, V:TES is the second-oldest active card game next to
Magic: the Gathering. Acclaimed for its high level of strategy and social
gaming, V:TES enjoys world-wide popularity among mature gamers. This European
Championship is a sister event to similar continental championships in North
America and Australia.
White Wolf Publishing (www.white-wolf.com) is a company dedicated to
redefining the art of storytelling. Since its birth in 1991, White Wolf has
consistently stretched the boundaries of familiar modes of artistic
entertainment, introducing new realms to the horror, science fiction and
fantasy genres. We began our journey with our now highly popular role-playing
lines, and then ventured into the realm of mass-market fiction publishing.
Now, we are involved in the electronic entertainment and television
industries.
